description.zh: 暖纸极简风 Obsidian 桌面待办便签（与 Tasks.md 实时双向同步），内置桌面倒计时磁贴（搜「倒计时 分钟数」即开即用）。
description.en: Warm-paper minimalist Obsidian desktop todo sticky tile synced with Tasks.md, plus a floating desktop countdown tile.

notes.zh: 首个公开发布版本：暖纸极简风 Obsidian 桌面待办便签（与 Tasks.md 实时无损双向同步，兼容 888bik.obsidian-quicknote 格式），支持圆角复选框、8 方向缩放、行内编辑、删除撤销、置顶与不透明度调节；内置独立桌面倒计时磁贴（方形水彩卡 / 圆形渐变表盘 / 极简胶囊条三形态切换、滚轮 ±1 分钟微调、真每像素透明投影与定制柔润风铃提示音）。
notes.en: Initial public release: warm-paper minimalist Obsidian desktop todo sticky tile with real-time lossless two-way Tasks.md sync (compatible with 888bik.obsidian-quicknote), featuring rounded checkboxes, 8-way resize, inline editing, undo delete, pin & opacity controls; plus a standalone layered floating countdown tile (Square Watercolor / Circular Gradient Dial / Minimal Pill shapes, ±1 min scroll adjustment, true per-pixel alpha shadow, and custom gentle chime).
